editarCom.js: (() => { const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('section h2')].filter(e => e.innerText.trim().split('\n')[0].trim() === "Comunicado")[0]; if (h) h.closest('section').dataset.print = "wc" })()

notas.js: (() => { const r = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog] div.rounded-lg')].filter(d => d.innerText.trim().startsWith("Bloco de notas")).sort((a, b) => a.innerText.length - b.innerText.length)[0]; [...r.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.innerText.trim() === 'Adicionar').click() })()
